## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

RaceRepositoryImpl — core-data/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/data/race/RaceRepositoryImpl.kt
ProfileRepositoryImpl — core-data/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/data/profile/ProfileRepositoryImpl.kt

## Trigger

None to observe — both are already called through the `RaceRepository`
and `ProfileRepository` interfaces by their existing consumers
(`RaceListViewModel`, `RaceDetailViewModel`, `ProfileViewModel`,
`ImportPreviewViewModel` in `:app-phone`) — observed. The fix is
internal to the two implementations, not a missing call to them.

## Today

`RaceRepositoryImpl` keeps every `Race` in a `LinkedHashMap<Long, Race>`
held in memory, guarded by a lock and published through a
`MutableStateFlow`. `ProfileRepositoryImpl` keeps a single `Profile` in
a `MutableStateFlow`, seeded with default values on construction.
Neither reads from nor writes to any on-device store — both classes'
own doc comments say so ("not yet backed by storage that survives
process death"). Nothing in `:core-data` declares a Room `@Entity`, a
`@Dao` or a `RoomDatabase`; `Grep` for `Room`, `@Entity`, `@Dao`,
`schemas` and `exportSchema` across the module returns nothing besides
the convention text itself. `core-data/build.gradle.kts` declares only
`project(":core-domain")` and `kotlinx-coroutines-core` as
dependencies — no Room artifact. `gradle/libs.versions.toml` has no
`room` version, no `androidx-room-*` library entry and no KSP/KAPT
plugin alias needed to process Room's annotations.

## Expected

`RaceRepositoryImpl` and `ProfileRepositoryImpl` read from and write to
a Room database that survives process death, so a race in progress, an
imported race and the profile's correction factor all outlive a
restart. This requires, in `:core-data`: a `RaceEntity` and a
`ProfileEntity` (or equivalent), a `RaceDao` and a `ProfileDao`, a
`RoomDatabase` declaring both, and its schema exported and versioned
per §8 of the conventions — none of which exist today. It also
requires the Room runtime (and its annotation processor) declared as a
dependency of `:core-data` and added as a version-catalogue entry in
`gradle/libs.versions.toml`, since neither is present in any build
file today.

RaceRepositoryImpl, ProfileRepositoryImpl, room (in libs.versions.toml)
